3 Statement by SCAR on Specially Protected Areas.
Treaty Recommendation VI-9 requested SCAR to tabulate, publish and evaluate information on the numbers of birds and seals killed or captured exchanged in accordance with the provisions of the Antarctic Treaty. Whilst SCAR is not specifically required to indicate its acceptance of these tasks, you may wish to inform your government that figures for 1964 to 1969 were published in SCAR Bulletin No 41 and at its Twelfth meeting SCAR agreed on mechanisms for tabulating, evaluating and publishing future figures.
. Yours faithfully,
G.E. Hemmen
Executive Secretary.
